title: TenderKG
abstract: arXiv:2608.14066v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Public procurement represents a major economic activity, where public institutions allocate contracts to companies through competitive tendering processes. Despite its importance, this domain remains underexplored by recommender systems, largely due to the lack of publicly available datasets capturing its complexity. In this paper, we introduce TenderKG, a large-scale knowledge graph dataset constructed from French public procurement data covering the period 2021--2023. The dataset models the procurement ecosystem through heterogeneous entities, including companies, tenders, lots, and domain-specific taxonomies of work domains, connected via rich semantic and structural relations. A key specificity of this setting is that only the awarded companies are visible, resulting in sparse explicit signals of awarded interactions. To overcome this limitation, TenderKG integrates extensive side information on the actors in the French tender market

translated_title: TenderKG：法国公共采购知识图谱数据集
translated_abstract: 公共采购是一项重要的经济活动，公共机构通过竞争性招标流程将合同分配给公司。尽管其重要性，这一领域在推荐系统中仍未得到充分探索，主要原因是缺乏公开可用的数据集来捕捉其复杂性。在本文中，我们介绍了TenderKG，一个从法国公共采购数据构建的大规模知识图谱数据集，覆盖2021年至2023年期间。该数据集通过异构实体（包括公司、招标、标段和工作领域特定分类法）对采购生态系统进行建模，并通过丰富的语义和结构关系进行连接。该设置的一个关键特殊性是只有中标公司可见，导致中标交互的显式信号稀疏。为克服这一限制，TenderKG整合了法国招标市场中参与者的广泛侧信息。
tldr: 本文提出了TenderKG，一个基于法国公共采购数据构建的大规模知识图谱数据集，通过整合丰富的侧信息来应对中标信号稀疏的挑战，为推荐系统在该领域的应用提供了基础资源。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TenderKG, a large-scale knowledge graph dataset constructed from French public procurement data, which addresses the challenge of sparse award signals by integrating extensive side information, providing a foundational resource for recommender systems in this domain.
